content: The document describes the software requirement for an android based arcade game clash of clans. It is intended for designer developer and maintainer of the application.

The function of this application is to provide a user with a really grate fun experience while playing this game. In this the user can connect to internet to access the full features of the game, where the user can collaborate or compete against each other through various interfaces provided with in the application.

The COC application does not run independently it has to collaborate with multiple servers owned by SUPERCELL through which all the functionality of the game are controlled and the user gets desires result as it requested.

It the client side interface for the application with which the user deals and makes its moves which passes through several serves throughout the world and give the user the desired result he requested for.

The application must be give several permissions on the user device for the better gaming experience.
As the game requires internet connection it should have access to allow use of data order to run the application.
The device must full fill the minimum specifications required to run the application on the device
0.5 GB of RAM(1 GB or more recommended).
Screen resolution of 800x480 or better.
The device must have a anodroid os of version 4.0.3 or higher to run the COC application on the user device.
The application requires internet connection to run on a device and to connect with other user over the network.

The application has to support the device on which it is installed and has to work in sync with the hardware components working on the backend of the application over the network to give the best gaming experience to the user. It has several in a pp functions such as in app purchase for which it has to maintain sync with the software and hardware required for making the payment when user demands. The application must handle all the process very efficiently and manage all the backed process with bothering the user or affecting the functionality of the user device.

It is the application developed for gamming purpose where the user can do a lot of stuffs from building its own city to fighting against beasts, challenging your own friend over the network for a fight and gain points and collects rewards to reach next level and to be on top of clan’s league. The user can also purchase items for its gamming through real time payment. The platform also provides time to time leagues which open for specific time and multiple users can connect to it and play against each other or support each other. The user can even share their resources with other friends over the coc network.

The customer or we can say the user interacts with the COC network via COC application. It must be very easy for the user to use the application and perform all the complex tasks without bothering the user. And it should support the system in all possible ways until unless the system meets the minimum requirements to run the application.

External interface requirements:
The interface of the coc application must be very easy to learn and play with with compromising with the gaming experience of the user.
Hardware interface:
The application must be give several permissions on the user device for the better gaming experience.
As the game requires internet connection it should have access to allow use of data order to run the application.
The device must full fill the minimum specifications required to run the application on the device
0.5 GB of RAM(1 GB or more recommended).
Screen resolution of 800x480 or better.
Software interface:
The device must have a anodroid os of version 4.0.3 or higher to run the COC application on the user device.
Communication interface:
The application requires internet connection to run on a device and to connect with other user over the network.
Performance requirements:
Messages should be displayed for any successful or unsuccessful action.
While performing in app purchase the payment must be secured via encryption and a good payment gateway must be used.
After every achievement or action completed by user the stats must be updated in real time for better gaming experience.
In Case of low network coverage message must be displayed to the user.
The response time between the request made and it being completed must very very less.
The application must be fast to load over the supported devices
